# [Selection for improved flight performance]{.underline}

## Flight performance factorial assay:

## Effects of Selection, Light Status and Fan Status on flight performance

See Methods section for details of experimental set-up.

### Call relevant packages

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)
library(AICcmodavg)
library(lmerTest)
library(effectsize)
library(glmmTMB)
library(car)
library(emmeans)
library(ggeffects)
library(broom)

theme_set(theme_cowplot())
```

### Import and wrangle data

Imported into a tibble "Flight_data"

```{r}
Flight_data <- read_excel("~/Flying_Flies_Phenotyping/Raw_data/FF_Phenotyping_Flight_Factorial.xlsx")

#head(Flight_data)

Flight_data <- Flight_data %>% 
  mutate(Light_Status = paste0("L_", Light), Fan_Status = paste0("F_", Fan)) %>% 
  mutate("ChamberNum" = parse_number(Chamber), "Fly_count" = replace_na(`Fly Count`, 0)) %>%
  mutate_at(c("Selection", "PopReplicate", "RunSet", "Light_Status", "Fan_Status"), factor)

```

### Calculating total flies per run, and per vial

```{r}
Totals <- Flight_data %>% 
  group_by(Selection, PopReplicate, RunSet, Light_Status, Fan_Status, Vials) %>% 
  summarise(Flies_per_run = sum(Fly_count)) %>% 
  mutate(Flies_per_vial = Flies_per_run/Vials)

```

### Proportion of flies per Chamber

```{r}
Flight_data <- Flight_data %>% group_by(Selection, PopReplicate, RunSet, Light_Status, Fan_Status) %>% 
  mutate(TotFlies = sum(Fly_count)) %>% mutate(Freq_per_chamber = Fly_count/TotFlies)

ggplot(data = Flight_data) + geom_point(aes(x = ChamberNum, y = Freq_per_chamber, color = Selection), position = position_dodge(width = 0.75))

ggplot(data = Flight_data) + geom_point(aes(x = ChamberNum, y = Freq_per_chamber, color = Light_Status), position = position_dodge(width = 0.75))

ggplot(data = Flight_data) + geom_point(aes(x = ChamberNum, y = Freq_per_chamber, color = Fan_Status), position = position_dodge(width = 0.75))

ggplot(data = Flight_data) + geom_point(aes(x = ChamberNum, y = Freq_per_chamber, color = Selection), position = position_dodge(width = 0.75)) + facet_wrap(~ Light_Status + Fan_Status)

```

NOTE: Might be a good idea to expand the frequency distribution and fit a zero inflated model. In this case each fly has its own data row.

Ways to analyse:

1.  Mean distance traversed
2.  Fit a zero inflated model to frequency distribution of flies in chambers
3.  compare frequency within non-selection chambers (Chamber 0, 1) and selection chambers (2+) (fit binomial distribution?)

### Mean Distance Traversed

```{r}
Mean_dist <- Flight_data %>% 
  group_by(Selection, PopReplicate, RunSet, Light_Status, Fan_Status) %>% 
  summarise(meandist = weighted.mean(ChamberNum, Freq_per_chamber))
  
Mean_dist <- Mean_dist %>% 
  mutate(PopRep = paste(Selection, PopReplicate, sep = "_")) %>% 
  mutate(RunSetNest = paste(PopRep, RunSet, sep = "_")) %>% 
  mutate_at(c("PopRep", "RunSetNest"), factor)
```

## Check AIC scores of models

```{r}
# Only Selection
fit_sel1 <- lmer(meandist ~ Selection + (1|PopRep),
                data = Mean_dist, REML = FALSE)

# Only Light
fit_light2 <- lmer(meandist ~ Light_Status + (1|PopRep),
                  data = Mean_dist, REML = FALSE)

# Only Fan
fit_fan3 <- lmer(meandist ~ Fan_Status + (1|PopRep),
                data = Mean_dist, REML = FALSE)

# All main effects
fit_main4 <- lmer(meandist ~ Selection + Light_Status + Fan_Status + (1|PopRep), data = Mean_dist, REML = FALSE)

# Selection crossed with Light_Status and Fan_Status
fit_selcross5 <- lmer(meandist ~ Selection:Light_Status + Selection:Fan_Status + (1|PopRep),
                 data = Mean_dist, REML = FALSE)

# Complete model
fit_factorial6 <- lmer(meandist ~ Selection*Light_Status*Fan_Status + (1|PopRep), data = Mean_dist, REML = FALSE)

aictab(cand.set = list(fit_sel1, fit_light2, fit_fan3, fit_main4, fit_selcross5, fit_factorial6))
```

Based on AICc scores, the model with main additive effects of Selection, Light_Status and Fan_Status has been selected.

### Calculating effect sizes

Both eta-squared and Cohen's F (analogous to Cohen's D when there are 2 levels) are calculated for the models with the highest support according to AICc.

```{r}
fit_main_reml <- lmer(meandist ~ Selection + Light_Status + Fan_Status + (1|PopRep), data = Mean_dist, REML = TRUE)
eta_squared(fit_main_reml)
cohens_f(fit_main_reml)

```

ANOVA on selected model

```{r}
anova_fit_main <- anova(fit_main_reml)

tidy(anova_fit_main)
```

## Plots

All plots made are for factors included in the best supported models.

#### Main effects of Selection, Light Status and Fan Status

```{r}
# convert data to long form with all factors under one column
Mean_dist_plots <- Mean_dist %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Selection, Light_Status, Fan_Status),
               names_to = "Factor", values_to = "fct_level") %>% 
  # Make boxplots for main effect comparisons
  ggplot(aes(x = fct_level, y = meandist, color = Factor)) + 
  facet_grid(.~Factor, scales = "free_x") +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = PopReplicate), 
             position = position_jitter(width = 0.1)) +
  stat_summary(fun = "mean", color = "black", shape = "-", size = 4) + 
  labs(x = "Comparison", y = "Mean Chambers Traversed")
print(Mean_dist_plots)

```

#### Save plot

```{r}
ggsave(Mean_dist_plots, filename = "../../Plots/Fact_meandist_main.jpeg", dpi = 400, width = 12, height = 6)
```

## Zero inflated negative binomial distribution

```{r}
Flight_data_merged <- Flight_data %>% left_join(
  Totals, 
  by = c("Selection", "PopReplicate", "RunSet", "Light_Status", "Fan_Status", "Vials")
)

Flight_zinbinom_data <- Flight_data_merged %>% 
  mutate(PopRep = paste(Selection, PopReplicate, sep = "_")) %>% 
  mutate(PopRep = as.factor(PopRep)) %>% 
  mutate(log_StartFlies = log(Flies_per_run)) %>% 
  select(Selection, Light_Status, Fan_Status, PopRep, log_StartFlies,
         ChamberNum, Fly_count)

# run zero inflated negative binomial test
zinbinom_mod <- glmmTMB(data = Flight_zinbinom_data,
  formula = Fly_count ~ ChamberNum * Selection * Light_Status * Fan_Status +
    offset(log_StartFlies) + (1|PopRep),
  ziformula = ~ ChamberNum,
  family = nbinom2,
)


Anova(zinbinom_mod, type = 'III')

emslopes <- emtrends(zinbinom_mod, ~Selection * Light_Status * Fan_Status, var = "ChamberNum")

summary(emslopes)
pairs(emslopes)

```

#### Plot this multi-interaction data with distance as a factor

```{r}
predictions <- predict_response(zinbinom_mod,
      terms = c("ChamberNum", "Selection", "Light_Status", "Fan_Status"),
      bias_correction = TRUE)

zinb_predict_plot <- plot(predictions) + 
  labs(x = "Distance traversed (Chamber)", y = "Predicted counts")

print(zinb_predict_plot)
```

## OLD CODE

#### Old AICtab code

Unused as of 21 April 2026. These were using a random block design.

```{r}
fit_mean_1 <- lmer(meandist ~ Selection + (1|PopRep), 
                   data = Mean_dist, REML = FALSE)
fit_mean_2 <- lmer(meandist ~ Selection + Light_Status + (1|PopRep) + (1|PopRep:Light_Status), 
                   data = Mean_dist, REML = FALSE)
fit_mean_3 <- lmer(meandist ~ Selection + Light_Status + Selection:Light_Status + (1|PopRep) + (1|PopRep:Light_Status), 
                   data = Mean_dist, REML = FALSE)
fit_mean_4 <- lmer(meandist ~ Selection + Light_Status + Fan_Status + (1|PopRep) + (1|PopRep:Light_Status) + (1|PopRep:Fan_Status), 
                   data = Mean_dist, REML = FALSE)
fit_mean_5 <- lmer(meandist ~ Selection * Light_Status * Fan_Status + (1|PopRep)+ (1|PopRep:Light_Status) + (1|PopRep:Fan_Status) + (1|PopRep:Light_Status:Fan_Status), 
                   data = Mean_dist, REML = FALSE)
fit_mean_6 <- lmer(
  meandist ~ Selection * Light_Status * Fan_Status + (1|PopRep) + (1|RunSetNest), 
  data = Mean_dist, REML = FALSE)

fit_mean_7 <- lmer(
  meandist ~ Selection + (1|Selection/PopRep),
  data = Mean_dist, REML = FALSE)

fit_mean_8 <- lmer(meandist ~ Selection + Light_Status + Fan_Status + (1|PopRep), 
                   data = Mean_dist, REML = FALSE)


aictab(cand.set = list(fit_mean_1, fit_mean_2, fit_mean_3, fit_mean_4, fit_mean_5, fit_mean_6, fit_mean_7, fit_mean_8))

```

#### OLD: Check AIC scores of models using dredge function

Unused as of 9 June 2026. Dredge function is less optimal than selecting models, due to brute-force variable selection which increases risk of overfitting.

```{r}
options(na.action = "na.fail") # required for dredge function

global_model_Dist <- lmer(data = Mean_dist, REML = FALSE,
  meandist ~ Selection * Light_Status * Fan_Status + (1|PopRep))

AIC_results <- dredge(global_model_Dist)

view(as.data.frame(AIC_results))

# model with the highest AIC weight
selected_model <- lmer(data = Mean_dist, REML = TRUE,
  meandist ~ Selection + Light_Status + Fan_Status + (1|PopRep))

eta_squared(selected_model)
cohens_f(selected_model)
```

Based on AICc scores, 'fit_mean_1' is selected. This considers only Selection.

model 2 (additive Selection, Light) and model 4 (additive Selection, Light, Fan) are also supported.

```{r}
fit_mean_1_reml <- lmer(meandist ~ Selection + (1|PopRep), 
                   data = Mean_dist, REML = TRUE)


fit_mean_3_reml <- lmer(meandist ~ Selection + Light_Status + (1|PopRep) + (1|PopRep:Light_Status) + Selection:Light_Status, data = Mean_dist, REML = TRUE)

fit_mean_4_reml <- lmer(meandist ~ Selection + Light_Status + Fan_Status + (1|PopRep) + (1|PopRep:Light_Status) + (1|PopRep:Fan_Status), 
                   data = Mean_dist, REML = TRUE)

fit_mean_5_reml <- lmer(meandist ~ Selection * Light_Status * Fan_Status + (1|PopRep)+ (1|PopRep:Light_Status) + (1|PopRep:Fan_Status) + (1|PopRep:Light_Status:Fan_Status), 
                   data = Mean_dist, REML = TRUE)

anova(fit_mean_1_reml)

```

### Calculating effect sizes

Both eta-squared and Cohen's F (analogous to Cohen's D when there are 2 levels) are calculated for the models with the highest support according to AICc.

```{r}
eta_squared(fit_mean_1)
eta_squared(fit_mean_4)
eta_squared(fit_mean_2)
eta_squared(fit_mean_5)
```

```{r}
cohens_f(fit_mean_4)
cohens_f(fit_mean_2)
cohens_f(fit_mean_5)
```
